description.value:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the iron gate

Effect Wet Blanket's discordant tune swells to a crescendo. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied] saving throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

details.description: Wet Blanket's invisible spirit plays a discordant tune that confounds the senses.
details.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:40] or @Check[intimidation|dc:40] (expert) twice to convince Wet Blanket to stay silent, @Check[occultism|dc:42] or @Check[religion|dc:42] (master) to exorcise Wet Blanket's spirit, or @Check[performance|dc:38] (expert) twice to drown out Wet Blanket's music. A PC holding Wet Blanket's fiddle of the maestro gains a +2 item bonus to any check made to disable the haunt.
details.reset: Unless the haunt is disabled, Wet Blanket falls silent once all creatures leave the room. She returns if another creature moves adjacent to the gate.
details.routine:
(1 action; auditory, concentrate, emotion, incapacitation, mental) Wet Blanket's tune causes creatures who hear it to act irrationally. Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:area-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:stunned|traits:auditory,concentrate,emotion,incapacitation,mental] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the tune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused] for 1 minute. They can attempt a new save at the end of each of their turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature immediately attacks themself. The Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.
